title: Home: no more empty space in Last week and beside the playoff picture
items: Last week now shows the model's record as a strip across the top, with Calls and Ranking moves side by side underneath, so neither column sits half empty.
When rankings for the week are not out yet, Calls takes the full width with best call and worst miss side by side.
While Last week is open, the playoff picture (football) and projected No. 1 seeds (basketball) list one team per row, so the side panel no longer leaves a gap above its View bracket link.
